rules.value: Indian passport holder resident in India
rules.quote: The applicant must be an Indian passport holder who is resident in India at the time ofapplication.
The applicant must be born on or after 1st January 1996.

rules.value: degree from recognised Indian university; final-year students may apply
rules.quote: The applicant must hold a degree from a recognised university in India. If you are in the final year of graduation and awaiting results, you are eligible to apply.
For Social Sciences, Humanities, Law, Fine Arts, Architecture and related subjects, applicants must have a minimum academic grade of 65%, CGPA 6.8/10, or GPA 2.6/4
For Mathematics, Sciences, Environment and related subjects, candidates must have a minimum academic grade of 70%, CGPA 7.2/10, or GPA 3/4
It is essential to have prior admission to the institution and course chosen at the time of the application.
The following subjects are not eligible for the Scholarship:
Applicants having a postgraduate qualification (e.g. Master’s or PhD) from an institution abroad are not eligible to apply.

amount.text: Up to USD 120,000 covering tuition, living, one-way travel, visa, health
amount.quote: covers tuition fees, living expenses, one-way travel, visa costs and health allowance, up to USD 120,000.

deadline.text: Applications closed for 2026; next cycle not announced
